visualCharacteristics.purpose: row of icon tabs switching between tool panels (Calendar, What Goes Where, Game, Need help?)

contentPattern.structure: one row per tab: label cell (text, optional icon) + panel content cell. A panel whose only content is a link to a /fragments/ page loads that fragment, so a panel can hold blocks

reuseGuidance: Use for tool switchers whose panels hold complex content; put each complex panel in a fragment.
